brand_system_version: AHEAD Brand Guidelines 2026 (AHEAD_StyleGuide_2026) and AHEAD PPT Template 2026 system (Brand Skill Update, November 2026)
refresh_status: 2026-style-guide-in-force; 2024 values are stale and fail validation

brand_team_only_accents.note: Carried over from the 2024 system. The 2026 guide does not restate accents; keep them off generated deliverables until Brand Marketing says otherwise.

legacy_2024.note: Stale 2024 palette. Never used in new work; the validator fails these values. Use the 2026 palette.

General (2026-AHEAD-PPT-Template, Dusk s.approved_by: Skill owner on behalf of Brand, 2026-11-11
General (2026-AHEAD-PPT-Template, Dusk s.note: Approved in decks built on the general template. Five values differ from the 2026 palette: 0B51ED (accent1, links), FB7440 (accent2), B9EBE7 (accent4), FFA269 (accent5), and 808AD5 (followed-link color only). When choosing colors yourself, prefer the 2026 palette and the chart series order.

chart.series_order_status: Confirmed by the Brand Team. Navy #123A61 added after Impact Green (skill owner, 2026-11-09).

gradients.rule: Monochromatic. Use no more than about 5% of the full gradient. Never use the center of the gradient. No fixed angle: the 2024 69-degree rule is retired. In decks, always use the published gradient image file for the theme; never recreate a gradient.

typography.source: AHEAD_StyleGuide_2026, Typography; Brand guidance 2026-11-12 (user-created materials use Aptos, Verdana backup; Parabolica is marketing-owned)

geometry.logo_clearspace_rule: no less than the height of the E in the logo

deck_logo_placement.source: AHEAD PPT Template 2026, content slide (Brand Skill Update - November 2026)
deck_logo_placement.position: bottom-right, same place on every content slide
deck_logo_placement.variant_on_dark_or_photo: AHEAD-Rev-Logo-WEB.png (reversed/white); AHEAD-KO-Logo-WEB.png (full-white knockout) only when the reversed logo cannot be used
deck_logo_placement.prefer: Read the position from the template layout. Use these numbers as a check, or when a layout is not available.
deck_logo_placement.padding_note: Sizes measure the visible logo. Bundled PNGs (1072x269) have transparent padding (visible bbox 6,32,1062,248 px).

shapes.application: Apply shapes zoomed in, rarely showing the full shape. Use borders and page breaks as natural interruptions.

deck_templates.source_folder: PowerPoint Templates (Official-Intranet-Files > ARCHIE Files > Marketing > Presentations and Visuals > Templates > PowerPoint Templates)
deck_templates.gradient_image_folder: PPT-Gradients (Logos and Brand Guidelines > Style Guide)
deck_templates.executive_files_role: Finished content, not templates. Deliver or insert slides as-is with light edits; never build new slides on them. New executive content uses the general template.

bundled_fallback.supplied: 2026-11-12 by the skill owner; the version Brand published to SharePoint on 2026-11-11
bundled_fallback.use_when: SharePoint can't be read for any deck template, including when the user asked for CoBrand. Live SharePoint file wins when readable. Not a substitute for the Executive Overviews decks.
bundled_fallback.cleanup: Replace 'AHEAD PPT TEMPLATE 2026' with the confidential footer in slides, layouts and master; set Arial, PT Sans, PT Serif, Poppins, Tenorite to Aptos; set #424242 to #333333.

retired_themes.retired: 2026-11-12 (removed from SharePoint by Brand; may return later)
retired_themes.on_request: Build on the general template and say the theme isn't available right now.

word_template.folder: Word Templates (Official-Intranet-Files > ARCHIE Files > Marketing > Presentations and Visuals > Templates)
word_template.letterhead: Letters use THE Word Template Final until Brand publishes a 2026 letterhead.

taglines.secondary: Digital Platforms for the Modern Enterprise

footers.client_formal: Confidential to AHEAD and [Client Short Name] — Page X of Y

logo_source_of_truth: AHEAD png Logos folder is canonical; bundled logos are fallback copies.
review_note_chat_only: Evergreen review is a chat note naming brand@ahead.com. Never insert a review block into the deliverable.
no_stale_fallback: Never use 2024 or earlier files, instructions, or guidelines for design, even as a fallback. Decks that can't reach SharePoint use the bundled general template.
sharepoint_reconnect_instruction: In Glean, go to Settings > Connectors and authorize SharePoint access.
messaging_status: messaging-voice.md confirmed current by Brand on 2026-11-11 (2026 upgrade builds on the 2024 guide).
